name: TOOLWARS
tagline: Free directory of 3,500+ real AI tools with verified click stats, weekly recaps and category benchmarks.
description: TOOLWARS is a free public discovery directory of 3,500+ real AI tools across 8 categories. Every listing shows verified click statistics with a published measurement methodology (bot traffic filtered and audited). Weekly recap pages and per-category benchmark pages summarise what people actually clicked. Tool makers can submit their tool free via a moderated queue and claim their listing with DNS TXT verification - no account needed. Sponsorship placements are clearly labeled as advertising. Operated from Estonia, EU/GDPR-compliant, no cookies.
